name: Scholar Eren
text: My head aches and my vision blurs… I can’t even read my notes anymore.

name: Scholar Eren
text: I once studied how mushrooms react with crystals — powerful stuff, if handled right.

name: Scholar Eren
text: And the juice of blueberries gave the potion a strong hue and clarity.

name: Scholar Eren
text: If I could have that again, perhaps I’d think straight.
